title: Sean McVay: Field goal unit "cost us the game tonight"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: Field goal unit "cost us the game tonight"
sources.description: The Rams fell to 2-3 on Monday night, due in part to a couple of missed field goals from kicker Harrison Mevis — including a blocked field goal in overtime that, if good, would have won the game.
